Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure

The team
We run the platform that serves retrieval-augmented LLM features to every product team.

What you will do
- Build retrieval infrastructure: embeddings, hybrid search and grounding for LLM applications.
- Design durable, event-driven ingestion that keeps search indexes fresh.
- Keep LLM output separated from correctness-critical deterministic systems.
- Build evaluation and testing workflows for LLM features.
- Operate large-scale inference services on GPUs with vLLM or Triton.

Minimum qualifications
- Experience building production systems with LLMs, RAG and embeddings.
- Experience with Python and one of Java, C# or C++.
- Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS).

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with PyTorch and CUDA.
- Experience with Azure AI Search or OpenSearch.
